title: SPACE INVADERS / TAITO BLUE UPRIGHT
variant: Taito blue upright with alien/moonscape sides, integrated title/bezel and one shared two-way joystick
preview_note: 32 x 48 px | Taito blue upright with alien/moonscape sides, integrated title/bezel and one shared two-way joystick

rom_validation.matching: All required files match pinned FBNeo CRC32 and size; existing legacy aliases are accepted.

cabinet.purpose: Photographed blue Taito upright: alien silhouettes, line grids, lunar foreground, white side/title lettering, integrated upright glass/bezel and white joystick, yellow Fire and two red Start buttons. Not the distinct red/yellow Taito America conversion panel.
cabinet.rights: Underlying printed artwork Taito / Midway; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

marquee.purpose: Title area rectified from the same documented integrated Taito blue bezel, not an unrelated marquee or the red/yellow American kit.
marquee.rights: Underlying printed artwork Taito / Midway; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

flyer.purpose: Original-design promotional print, retained for release/artwork provenance; regional cabinet identity follows the blue Taito photograph rather than silently mixing variants.
flyer.rights: Underlying printed artwork Taito / Midway; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

screen.purpose: Real 224x260 upright gameplay, from the rebuilt classics core, four matching supplied program ROMs and nine-coin state; Start 15 frames then 300 neutral frames. Core color overlay retained.
screen.rights: Game imagery Taito / Midway, captured from user-supplied local ROM only. No ROM downloaded, uploaded or committed; no redistribution license inferred.

uncertainties: Publisher-hosted artwork masters were not found. Archive photographs/scans are not proof of factory prints or artwork redistribution permission.
This selected shell/kit interpretation is explicit; ROM, hardware and seat count are not changed to suit artwork. No map placement or uploads included.
One photographed side is reused on the opposite side with readable lettering; the distinct opposite factory print is unverified and is not invented.
Space Invaders is sequential two-player play with one shared two-way stick. Three modeled panel buttons are Fire plus the two Start buttons; game actions are not three firing buttons.
The archive red/yellow Taito America panel is a different conversion variant and was examined but not used; this cabinet retains its photographed blue panel.
The flat-front tall glass/bezel geometry approximates the photographed Taito shell at sprite scale; it does not simulate an optical reflected-monitor installation.
Thin alien raster strokes are brightened 3x after aspect-preserving downsampling for native-size legibility; original captured reference remains unchanged.

The four program ROMs are complete. This FBNeo driver needs a separate invaders audio sample set (1-9.wav and 18.wav), absent from the supplied 5KB program ZIP and local files. It is currently silent; no sound samples or ROMs were downloaded.

The rebuilt classics core contains the existing replay fixes and changes state size. Refreshed local states for Pac-Man, Atari Tetris and Wonder Boy are staged separately to keep those games compatible; their earlier states are backed up and artwork is unchanged.
